body.name: tilde_tau
body.def: In \(\mathfrak E_X(z_0,\Sigma)\), \(\widetilde\tau\) is measurable in the observations and the known specifications \(X,z_0,\Sigma\), and is selected before the unknown labelled point.  In an outer fixed-query minimax display it denotes one \(\mathcal O\)-measurable rule selected before the unknown donor mean \(z_0\) and labelled kernel.  It never accesses potential outcomes or nuisance labels.
